comment: Capabilities of the boot image shipped next to this file. The worker reads it so a new image can announce what it supports without an API change. oplScheduling: the guest stamps OPL writes with the moment they belong to (top 15 bits of the /dev/opl word).
guest: NOMMU Linux 6.19 (subleq) + BusyBox + fbdoom with /dev/dsp SFX, time-stamped /dev/opl music and /dev/wad host WAD
